verdict.rationale: Attio documents workflow automations with triggers (e.g., new deal created) and AI-driven 'agents' (Web Agent, Routing Agent, Scoring Agent) that run automatically in the background, plus webhooks for real-time event handling. However, there's no independent/hands-on evidence of true autonomous multi-step agentic execution or scheduling reliability beyond first-party marketing copy. Missing for 10: independent verification of autonomous background execution, details on failure handling/monitoring of these automations, and evidence beyond vendor marketing pages.
